note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. universal_conscription: compulsory male military service (with conscientious-objector alternative service) was still in force; Law 17/1999 provided for its suspension, which Royal Decree 247/2001 brought forward to 31 December 2001. national_health_service: the tax-funded universal National Health System. pluralist_secularism: the 1978 Constitution makes the state non-confessional while requiring cooperation with the Catholic Church and other confessions. free_trade reflects EU single-market membership. energy_mix and open_internet are judgement calls for 2000.
